title: ATLAS Vercel Hobby-plan review-override record
description: A committed record binding a human 'keep_hobby' decision to an exact guardrail-comparison signature digest and the exact set of currently-drifted fields it covers. This is Git-reviewed governance evidence, not independent cryptographic attestation -- nothing in this codebase requires the review commit to come from a different author than the drift-state commit; the control's strength is ordinary git-history auditability. Lives under docs/registry/vercel-hobby-reviews/<repo_id>.latest.json -- NOT under data/**, which is gitignored. No instance of this record should be committed speculatively: it must correspond to a real, current generated guardrail signature and an explicit human review, never manufactured merely to populate the path.

checkpoint_status.description: Only 'ready' is meaningful; any other value is rejected by ops/atlas/vercel_hobby_decision_checkpoint.py's _load_matching_review().

decision.description: The only decision value this record type currently exists to encode.

accepted_signature_digest.description: SHA-256 (or equivalent) digest of the guardrail comparison signature this review was performed against. Must exactly match the current signature or the review is treated as stale and rejected.

accepted_drift_fields.description: Every field name the review explicitly covers. Must be a superset of the currently-drifted fields or the review is rejected as not covering current drift.

target_sha.description: Optional, audit-only. Surfaced as review_target_sha / review_target_sha_authority="audit_only" in the checkpoint output and never validated against anything -- there is no independently trustworthy source for "the guardrail's current source commit" to check it against.

decision_reason.description: Optional human-readable rationale for the decision, propagated through unchanged to the checkpoint output's decision_reason field. Not used in any authority/matching logic.

next_action.description: Optional human-readable operator guidance, propagated through unchanged to the checkpoint output's next_action field. Not used in any authority/matching logic.
